description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
